composition: large framed work centered in gallery
description: Gallery installation view of a large-scale mixed-media work mounted in a black frame, depicting multiple top-down warplane silhouettes arranged across an ivory ground with red rectangular outlines and yellow vertical stripes. Perforated dots and concentric ring motifs appear along the lower register; the surrounding gallery space includes additional framed works on flanking walls.
title: Untitled (Gallery Guernica View)
